Artifact list names the published evidence files; every file is pinned in public_artifacts with hash, origin and privacy review, and the article links their repository paths.
Deployment-lag caveat tells the reader a fresh 404 is a pending commit rather than a missing file; the paths in the links match the evidence directory in this tree.
Limitations block: one shared 2-vCPU host, ten requests, 6.7x spread over five cold prefills of the same fixture (941-977 tokens), no engine-source inspection, no hosted-caching claim.
